## 4. Elections — result and how every voter group voted

A voter group is district · occupation · income band · values cohort (TRAD traditional, PRAG pragmatic, PROG progressive). Adults = voting-age people in the group. Shares are the group's vote split (%). Approval = the group's approval of the government (%). Biggest worry = the concern with the highest salience × dissatisfaction.
